app.title: Show HN: Spindle – a full-featured, type-safe web framework for OCaml 5
app.author: zaiev
app.description: A type-safe web framework for OCaml 5 that emphasizes safety and ergonomics, offering a minimal yet powerful API for building HTTP services.
proposed_tests: Install the framework via opam or dune and run the example 'hello world' project.
Verify that a simple GET endpoint returns the expected response.
Measure startup time of the dev server.
Send 100 concurrent requests and record throughput.
Check that type errors are caught at compile time by modifying a handler signature.
